Police found 543 of 2,760 cases involved perpetrators with earlier domestic, dating, stalking or sexual violence. On Jeju, a former girlfriend was fatally stabbed after reporting alleged stalking, sexual violence and dating violence four times. In Seoul, police said another suspect had stalked his wife 18 times, including nine times under a court order. Rep. Kim Nam-hee plans an amendment covering coercive relationships, tracking tools, digital control and threats.

cards.korean_desc: 한국의 80대 남성이 2000년대 초 마약 운반을 도운 혐의를 받습니다. 경찰은 그가 2002년부터 2004년까지 다섯 번 코카인 5,385킬로그램을 운반했다고 봅니다. 코카인 가치는 약 4조 8천억 원, 36억 달러로 추정됐습니다. 공범들이 체포된 뒤 그는 2004년쯤 가나로 도망가 약 22년 머물렀습니다. 부산해경은 그를 인터폴 수배 명단에 올리고 가나 경찰과 위치를 확인했습니다. 가나는 그를 추방했고 한국 당국은 2026년 10월 20일 송환했습니다.
cards.english_desc: A South Korean man in his 80s is suspected of helping transport narcotics in the early 2000s. Police allege he transported 5,385 kilograms of cocaine on five occasions between 2002 and 2004. The cocaine was estimated to be worth about 4.8 trillion won, or $3.6 billion. After accomplices were arrested, he fled to Ghana around 2004 and remained there for about 22 years. The Busan Coast Guard placed him on Interpol’s wanted list and confirmed his location with Ghanaian police. Ghana deported him, and Korean authorities brought him home on October 20, 2026.
cards.hook: A drug suspect returned after 22 years in Ghana.
cards.takeaway_english: The suspect now faces the next stage of the Korean investigation.
cards.takeaway_korean: 피의자는 이제 한국 수사의 다음 절차를 맞게 됩니다.

cards.english_title: North Korea honors fallen Chinese soldiers
cards.korean_desc: 북한과 중국은 중국군의 1950~53년 한국전쟁 참전 기념일을 맞았습니다. 10월 25일 김정은은 단둥에서 중국군 전쟁기념관을 방문했습니다. 다음 날 북한 officials는 평양 우의탑에 헌화했습니다. 고위 officials와 중국대사관 representatives는 북한 여러 곳의 중국군 묘도 추모했습니다. 김정은의 단둥 방문에는 연회와 버스공장, 신압록강대교 방문도 있었습니다. 분석가들은 북미 대화 논의가 실제로 있었는지 의견이 갈렸습니다.
cards.english_desc: North Korea and China marked the anniversary of Chinese entry into the 1950-53 Korean War. On October 25, Kim Jong-un visited Dandong and honored Chinese soldiers at a war memorial. The next day, North Korean officials laid wreaths at Pyongyang’s Friendship Tower. Senior officials and Chinese embassy representatives also honored Chinese graves in several North Korean locations. Kim’s Dandong trip also included a banquet, a bus factory visit and a crossing of the New Yalu River Bridge. Analysts disagreed on whether the meeting involved concrete discussion of renewed North Korea-US dialogue.
cards.hook: North Korea honored Chinese soldiers and emphasized its alliance.
cards.takeaway_english: The ceremony was clear, but the private diplomatic discussions remain uncertain.
cards.takeaway_korean: 추모식은 분명했지만 비공개 외교 논의는 불확실합니다.

why_it_matters.english: The ceremony linked wartime memory with current North Korea-China relations.
why_it_matters.korean: 이 행사는 전쟁의 기억을 현재의 북중 관계와 연결했습니다.

why_it_matters.english: The visit may shape discussion about trade, diplomacy and regional security.
why_it_matters.korean: 이번 방문은 무역과 외교, 지역 안보 논의에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.

cards.english_desc: Choi Kil-su began work as South Korea’s presidential special inspector on October 26, 2026. President Lee Jae Myung formally appointed him on October 23 after the post had been vacant since late 2016. The office investigates corruption allegations involving the president’s spouse, relatives and senior presidential aides. Choi said he would gather information proactively instead of waiting for complaints or lawsuits. He compared the office to a panopticon, a design allowing constant observation of inmates. He also said people outside the legal target group cannot be investigated by his office.
cards.hook: The new inspector promised independence and political neutrality.

cards.english_title: AI shoppers test Korea’s retail market
cards.korean_desc: 이 합성 소비자는 구매 행동을 흉내 내 제품과 가격, 매장을 시험합니다. 롯데는 L.Point 구매 데이터와 소셜미디어 정보로 AI 트윈 소비자를 개발합니다. L.Point에는 약 4,500만 명의 멤버십 구매 데이터가 쌓여 있습니다. 쿠팡과 네이버는 온라인 이동에서 망설임과 이탈, 구매 취소를 찾습니다. 인텔리시아는 합성 소비자가 500명 조사와 91.2% 일치했다고 말합니다.
cards.english_desc: These synthetic consumers mimic purchasing behavior and help companies test products, prices and store designs. Lotte is building an AI Twin Consumer from L.Point purchasing data and social media information. L.Point contains accumulated purchasing data from about 45 million membership-program users. Coupang and Naver are simulating online journeys to find hesitation, loss of interest and canceled purchases. Intellicia says its synthetic consumers matched a 500-person survey by 91.2 percent in benchmark testing.
cards.hook: Retailers are testing products on virtual shoppers first.
cards.korean_hook: 유통업체들은 먼저 가상 쇼핑객에게 제품을 시험합니다.
cards.takeaway_english: The technology promises speed, but its claims still depend heavily on company testing.
cards.takeaway_korean: 이 기술은 빠르지만, 주장은 여전히 기업 시험에 크게 의존합니다.

why_it_matters.english: Companies may change products and stores before spending money on full production or renovations.
why_it_matters.korean: 기업은 대량 생산이나 매장 개편 전에 제품과 매장을 바꿀 수 있습니다.

why_it_matters.english: Consumers’ data and social media information may influence virtual shopping decisions.
why_it_matters.korean: 소비자 데이터와 소셜미디어 정보가 가상 쇼핑 결정에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.

cards.korean_desc: 한국: 2천년 창의의 여정은 2026년 10월 1일 런던에서 열렸다. 전시에는 한국 유물과 작품 185점이 있으며 영국에 처음 소개된 것도 많다. 전시는 영국박물관과 한국 두 국립박물관, 삼성전자의 협력이다. 많은 작품은 2021년 한국에 기증된 이건희 컬렉션에서 왔다. 전시는 2027년 1월 31일까지 열리고 한국문화원 전시도 런던에서 열린다.
cards.english_desc: “Korea: 2,000 Years of Creativity” opened at the British Museum on October 1, 2026. The show contains 185 Korean artifacts and original artworks, many previously unseen in Britain. The exhibition is a collaboration among the British Museum, Korea’s two national museums and Samsung Electronics. Many objects came from the late Samsung chairman Lee Kun-hee’s collection, donated to South Korea in 2021. The show runs until January 31, 2027, while another Korean art exhibition runs nearby at the Korean Cultural Centre UK.

cards.korean_desc: 2026년 첫 8개월 동안 크루즈선이 외국인 승객과 승무원을 한국에 데려왔다. 이는 지난해 같은 기간보다 12% 증가했다. 제주 서귀포가 그 기간 해상 입국자의 절반 이상을 받았다. 중국인은 입국자의 57.7%로 가장 큰 국적 집단이었다. 4분기 148회 입항과 638,905명 방문이 예정돼 연간 수치는 200만명을 넘을 수 있다.
cards.english_desc: Cruise ships brought many foreign passengers and crew members to South Korea during the first eight months of 2026. That total was 12 percent higher than the same period a year earlier, according to the report. Seogwipo on Jeju Island received more than half of all sea arrivals during that period. Chinese citizens formed the largest nationality group, making up 57.7 percent of arrivals. With 148 port calls and 638,905 passengers planned for the fourth quarter, the yearly total could exceed two million.

cards.takeaway_english: Korea’s cruise tourism may pass two million arrivals in 2026 if scheduled visits happen.

cards.english_title: Lions Veteran May Cede the Spotlight
cards.korean_desc: 삼성 라이온즈는 대구에서 KIA 타이거즈와 5전 3선승제 플레이오프를 준비했다. 2026년 정규시즌, 최형우는 타율 3할과 타점 100개를 기록한 7명 중 한 명이었다. 하지만 햄스트링 부상에서 돌아온 구자욱 때문에 최형우는 선발에서 빠졌다. 박진만 감독은 수비가 더 좋은 26세 박승규를 좌익수로 넣었다. 그러나 비로 1차전은 10월 26일 오후 6시 30분으로 미뤄졌다. KIA는 앞선 준플레이오프에서 LG 트윈스를 세 경기 연속 이겼다. 최형우는 대타 역할을 받아들였지만, 수비 출전 여부는 아직 확인되지 않았다.
cards.english_desc: On October 25, Samsung Lions prepared for a best-of-five playoff against KIA Tigers in Daegu. In the 2026 regular season, Choi was one of seven players with a .300 average and 100 RBIs. Still, Samsung left him out of the starting lineup because Koo Ja-wook was returning from a hamstring injury. Manager Park chose 26-year-old Park Seung-kyu in left field for stronger defense. However, rain canceled Game 1 on October 25 and moved it to 6:30 p.m. on October 26. KIA had swept the LG Twins in the previous round, adding pressure before the delayed opener. Choi accepted a pinch-hitting role, but reports had not confirmed whether he would field on October 26.
cards.hook: Choi is ready to let younger teammates start.
cards.takeaway_english: The delayed opener will show whether Choi is used as a hitter or fielder.
cards.takeaway_korean: 미뤄진 첫 경기에서 최형우가 타자나 수비수로 나설지 드러난다.

why_it_matters.english: A veteran's role can change when defense and injuries shape a playoff lineup.
why_it_matters.korean: 수비와 부상이 플레이오프 선발을 바꾸면 베테랑의 역할도 달라질 수 있다.

cards.english_title: South Korea Wins 29 Asian Para Games Golds
cards.korean_desc: 2026년 아이치·나고야 아시아 파라게임은 10월 18일부터 24일까지 일본에서 열렸습니다. 한국은 10월 24일 일본에서 금메달 29개로 5위를 차지했습니다. 한국은 은메달 38개와 동메달 33개도 따냈습니다. 마지막 날 혼성 사브르 은메달로 총 메달 100개를 채웠습니다. 탁구는 금메달 12개, 사이클은 7개를 보탰습니다. 반면 사격과 보치아는 목표를 달성하지 못했습니다. 대회 깃발은 2030년 개최지 도하로 전달됐습니다.
cards.english_desc: The Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Para Games took place in Japan from October 18 to 24. South Korea finished fifth in Japan on October 24 with 29 gold medals. The Korean delegation also won 38 silver medals and 33 bronze medals. A mixed-team sabre silver on the final day brought Korea's total to 100 medals. Table tennis added 12 gold medals, while cycling added seven. However, shooting and boccia did not meet their gold-medal targets. The Games flag was handed to Doha, host city of the 2030 Asian Para Games.
cards.hook: Korea aimed for 21 golds. It won 29.
cards.takeaway_english: Korea must protect its strong events while rebuilding weaker ones.
cards.takeaway_korean: 한국은 강한 종목을 지키며 약한 종목을 다시 키워야 합니다.

cards.korean_desc: 2026년 10월 24일 아부다비 UFC 333에서 챔피언 볼카노프스키가 무패 도전자 에블로예프와 맞붙었다. 볼카노프스키는 두 차례 챔피언이었고, 에블로예프는 프로 20경기 무패였다. 조심스러운 1라운드 뒤, 챔피언은 2라운드에 정확한 타격을 넣기 시작했다. 강력한 연타로 에블로예프가 케이지로 밀렸고, 볼카노프스키는 2라운드 4분 54초에 타격으로 끝냈다. 마크 고더드 주심은 라운드 6초를 남기고 경기를 중단했다. 경기 뒤 그는 결혼기념일 주간에 아내에게 빠른 승리를 약속했다고 말했다. UFC는 알도보다 앞섰다고 했지만, 워싱턴포스트는 동률이라고 보도했다. 확인한 두 보도는 다음 상대를 밝히지 않았다.
cards.english_desc: At UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi on October 24, 2026, champion Alexander Volkanovski faced unbeaten Russian challenger Movsar Evloev. Volkanovski entered as a two-time champion, while Evloev brought a 20-fight professional unbeaten run. After a cautious opening round, the champion began landing precise strikes in the second. A powerful combination drove Evloev to the cage before Volkanovski finished him with strikes at 4:54. Referee Marc Goddard stopped the contest with six seconds left in the round. Afterward, Volkanovski said he had promised his wife a quick win on their wedding anniversary week. The UFC said he moved ahead of Jose Aldo, but The Washington Post reported that he tied Aldo. Both reports reviewed here leave Volkanovski’s next opponent unannounced.
cards.hook: Volkanovski promised speed. He delivered a second-round TKO.
cards.takeaway_english: The title stays with Volkanovski, but the division’s next move remains unstated.
cards.takeaway_korean: 타이틀은 남았지만, 다음 계획은 아직 나오지 않았다.

cards.english_desc: Plave is a five-member virtual K-pop group whose performers appear through animated avatars. On October 19, Hanteo reported that Plave’s “Hyperdrive” sold 1,322,973 copies during its first week. That surpassed the 1,255,801-copy record set by Caligo Pt. 2 in April. By midnight on October 13, all five tracks had entered Melon’s top five. The rise continued from about 28,000 debut-week copies in March 2023 to about 569,000 in 2024. In February 2025, Caligo Pt. 1 made Plave the first virtual idol group past one million first-week sales. The official schedule next lists a Pasadena, California concert on November 14, 2026.

cards.korean_desc: 한때 K팝 그룹은 방송 예능에 의지해 개성을 보여 줬다. 이제 아이돌 채널은 게임과 미션, 일상을 정기 예능으로 만든다. BTS는 2015년 런 BTS를 시작해 초기 모델을 세웠다. 세븐틴의 고잉 세븐틴은 주간 예능이 되어 팬덤 밖 시청자도 끌었다. 2026년 3월 말 리센느 원이의 영상이 거제 야호 열풍을 일으켰다. 보도는 큰 도달을 보여 주지만, 성장의 유일한 원인임을 증명하지는 않는다.
cards.english_desc: K-pop groups once relied on television variety shows to show fans their personalities. Now idol-run channels turn games, missions and everyday moments into regular entertainment. BTS launched Run BTS in 2015, helping establish an early model outside conventional broadcasters. Seventeen’s Going Seventeen later grew into a weekly variety show and attracted viewers beyond Carat. In late March 2026, RESCENE’s Woni sparked viral interest with Geoje, yaho! clips. The coverage shows strong reach, but it does not prove self-produced content alone caused every group’s growth.

cards.english_desc: Hanroro announced her fifth solo concert, “Question Mark,” on October 23, 2026. On January 2 and 3, 2027, Hanroro will perform twice at Inspire Arena in Incheon. In November 2025, two sold-out shows at Korea University drew about 9,000 people in total. In the first half of 2026, two Hanroro songs ranked first and second on Circle Chart’s digital ranking. A later ticket notice listed 120-minute shows, with general sales opening November 13 at 6 p.m.

cards.english_desc: On October 23, the Justice Department sent letters to California county election officials before the midterm elections. The letters asked counties to sequester ballots tied to roughly 20,000 people and provide information within 48 hours. California’s attorney general’s office said the list contained errors, including nonresidents in Mendocino County. Local election officials had begun counting ballots, and one registrar said the election would continue. The Justice Department said it wanted cooperation, not voter-roll purges, registration cancellations, or broad administrative action. On October 25, a Ninth Circuit panel questioned the demand’s timing, constitutionality, and federal authority. The latest reports describe competing claims but no final court ruling.

cards.english_desc: On Friday, two Palestinians killed two soldiers near Hebron before they were shot dead. The army said it operated in 40 West Bank areas and apprehended about 40 suspects over Friday and Saturday. cards.english_title: Obama condemns a personal Ohio attack ad
cards.korean_desc: 그는 비벡 라마스와미가 에이미 액턴의 친어머니를 광고에 이용했다고 비판했다. 그 광고는 액턴을 거짓말쟁이라고 부르고 정신 건강을 의심하게 했다. 액턴은 어린 시절 학대와 방임과 노숙을 겪었다고 말했다. 2026년 10월 20일, 라마스와미 선거운동은 광고 제작을 인정하고 400만 달러를 쓰겠다고 밝혔다. 10월 21일, 팩트체크닷오알지는 법원 기록이 액턴의 설명 일부를 뒷받침한다고 보도했다. 공화당은 갈렸다: 드와인은 철회를 요구했고, 밴스와 트럼프는 광고를 옹호했다.
cards.english_desc: He criticized Vivek Ramaswamy for using Amy Acton’s estranged mother in an Ohio governor’s race advertisement. The ad called Acton a liar and questioned her mental health while describing her childhood. Acton says she faced abuse, neglect, and homelessness before being removed from her mother’s custody at age 12. On October 20, Ramaswamy’s campaign confirmed making the ad and promised $4 million for promotion. On October 21, FactCheck.org reported that court records supported key parts of Acton’s account. Republicans split: Mike DeWine urged removal, while JD Vance and Donald Trump defended it.

cards.english_desc: On October 25, a dispute over satellite communications grew between Ukraine and the United States. After more than a week of restrictions, Ukraine said Starlink and Starshield had returned to needed operating speeds on Saturday. Officials said the slowdown limited Starshield to 160 kilometers per hour, hurting drone interception and canceling operations. The Defense Ministry later said the connection stayed stable above 400 kilometers per hour. Musk then said Ukraine had used Starlink for offensive drone strikes, violating service terms. A Ukrainian presidential adviser rejected that explanation, saying the restrictions made such missions physically impossible. The available reports do not settle who imposed the restrictions or whether Ukraine breached the rules.

sentences.english: After more than a week of restrictions, Ukraine said Starlink and Starshield had returned to needed operating speeds on Saturday.
sentences.korean: 일주일 넘는 제한 뒤, 우크라이나는 토요일 필요한 속도가 돌아왔다고 말했습니다.

sentences.english: Officials said the slowdown limited Starshield to 160 kilometers per hour, hurting drone interception and canceling operations.
sentences.korean: 관계자들은 스타실드가 시속 160킬로미터로 제한돼 드론 요격이 어려워졌다고 말했습니다.

sentences.english: The Defense Ministry later said the connection stayed stable above 400 kilometers per hour.
sentences.korean: 국방부는 연결이 시속 400킬로미터 이상에서 안정적이었다고 밝혔습니다.

sentences.english: Musk then said Ukraine had used Starlink for offensive drone strikes, violating service terms.
sentences.korean: 머스크는 우크라이나가 공격용 드론에 스타링크를 써 약관을 어겼다고 말했습니다.

sentences.english: A Ukrainian presidential adviser rejected that explanation, saying the restrictions made such missions physically impossible.
sentences.korean: 우크라이나 대통령 보좌관은 제한 때문에 그런 작전이 물리적으로 불가능했다고 반박했습니다.

sentences.english: The available reports do not settle who imposed the restrictions or whether Ukraine breached the rules.
sentences.korean: 현재 보도만으로는 제한 주체와 약관 위반 여부가 확정되지 않았습니다.
